# oracle/

Fixed test corpus + libdeflate-instrumented oracle traces for the
multi-slice pure-Go libdeflate port (slice 0).  Regenerated by:

```
cd reference_code/libdeflate_trace && make oracle
```

Each `<name>` has three files:

- `<name>.bin`     — raw input (deterministic; see `make_corpus.py`)
- `<name>.gz`      — gzip-framed output of libdeflate `--level 6`
- `<name>.trace`   — BTRACE events emitted by the instrumented encoder
                     (one event per internal decision)

Subsequent slices port the Go encoder against `<name>.trace` and assert
its bit-stream output matches `<name>.gz`.  Do not edit by hand —
regenerate from the harness.
